answer_1.quote: Generative commonsense reasoning (GCR) is a type of constrained text generation task that requires compositional generalization capabilities, where LLMs are tasked with creating natural, commonsense sentences that include all given concepts...
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences that contain all concepts from each concept set, optionally respecting a specified order

answer_2.quote: We report three types of coverage rates... we evaluate diversity of generated sentences by computing the average pairwise similarity across all 24 sentences... using Pairwise-BLEU (pBLEU), Pairwise-BLEURT (pBLEURT), Distinct, Diverse Rate, and perplexity via LMPPL...
